info.title: Triage X
info.synopsis: La clinica Mochizuki è segretamente la base operativa della Black Label, un'organizzazione composta da medici e infermiere, dedita a estirpare i tumori che affliggono la società . Attraverso il sistema del triage, lo stimato direttore dell'ospedale, il dottor Mochizuki, seleziona i soggetti da eliminare, criminali senza speranza di guarire dal male di cui sono portatori. Nel team incaricato di eseguire queste missioni segrete c'è anche Arashi Mikami, di giorno comune studente e di notte spietato assassino.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: A triage is when several people are injured and a system is employed where five different label colors are applied based on the severity and urgency of the injuries, and then the people are treated based on that system. Black is the closest color to death. The illegal organization Black Label, applies these labels of death to criminals that eat away at society, just like malignant tumors, and run operations to stop them.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Mikami Arashi, a high school student, has excised his first malignant tumor, and is now an official member of the illegal organization, Black Label. He took on the role of executioner because of what happened nine years ago during an act of terrorism against an international medical conference. And now Black Label moves to save a victim which has been kidnapped right after they saved them the last time.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Kiba Mikoto, a student at the same school as Arashi, fights evil along with him part of the organization, Black Label. Mikoto runs into a mysterious transfer student, Hizaki Chikage. Mikoto learns a lot about Chikage, and the two of them get very close. Meanwhile, a string of incidents happen where citizens are being burned to death...
